title: EventConductor task contract
description: The contract of a worker task: the shape a definition's ACTION step commits to when it references this task by id. Lives in a .ectask file under definitions/tasks/. A backward-incompatible change is a new version; a step pins the version it was imported against.

id.description: Stable identifier of the task, unique across all groups. A step references it with `task: <id>` or `task: <id>@<version>`.

version.description: Contract version. A backward-incompatible change (a removed/renamed field, a tightened type, a moved group) is a new version. A service may implement several versions at once.

group.description: Free-form grouping; one group is one generated module (artifactId defaults to `<group>-tasks`). An id belongs to exactly one group; moving a task to another group is a breaking change.

topic.description: Default transport destination (Kafka topic) for steps that use this task. An explicit `topic` on the step overrides it.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the task does.

input.description: The variables the task expects, by name. Declaration order is significant (it is the order of the generated Input record's components).

output.description: The variables the task returns, by name. Declaration order is significant.

errors.description: The business errors the task may report. Each becomes a typed exception in the generated code and, when thrown, fails the step with its code as the reason.

attributes.description: A map of attribute name to its declaration.

type.description: The attribute's type. `object` is an opaque JSON object; `array` requires `items`.

required.description: Whether the task cannot run without this attribute.

items.description: The element type, required when `type` is `array`.

code.description: A code that is also a valid Java identifier, so it maps to a generated exception type.
